 Connect customers with the right internal resources, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value. Contribute to the evolution of scalable programs that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and measurable outcomes

Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. Familiarity with designing workflows or engagement strategies using AI or automation-driven tools

title: 硬件工程师
company: 梅卡曼德（雄安）机器人科技股份有限公司
description:
岗位定位（Whythisrole）​

工业3D相机的硬件设计，本质上是一场在有限体积与功耗约束下的精度战争：你选的每一颗器件、每一毫伏电源噪声、每一条高速链路的信号质量，最终都会体现为成像表现和现场稳定性。你将负责工业3D相机及视觉系统的硬件方案与电路设计，从需求定义一路负责到量产落地——不是画完原理图就交接，而是用真实工业现场的表现检验你的每一个设计取舍。



你将负责（Whatyouown）​

1、主导硬件架构设计与关键器件选型，在成像性能、传输、功耗、体积与成本之间做出有依据、可辩护的取舍；

2、端到端负责原理图设计，制定PCB约束并协同Layout，把信号质量、供电稳定性与抗干扰要求落实到每一层设计；

3、主导板级调试与系统联调，用测量和实验验证设计判断，推动问题闭环；

4、与验证、制造团队协作，推动硬件方案通过性能与可靠性验证并完成量产导入，对试制和现场暴露的设计问题负责到底；

5、把有效的电路方案和调试经验沉淀为可复用的设计模块与规范，让下一代产品开发更快、犯错更少。



核心挑战（Whyit'shard）​

1、约束博弈：体积、功耗、成本与成像质量相互挤压，没有"全都好"的方案，只有有依据的取舍；

2、高速与噪声的物理边界：电源完整性、信号完整性、EMC问题往往在设计定型后才暴露，需要预判而非补救；

3、现场与实验室的鸿沟：工业现场的环境应力会放大设计裕量不足，问题定位常常横跨硬件与软硬件交互。



任职要求（Must-have）​

1、本科及以上学历，电子、通信、自动化、仪器等相关专业；

2、扎实的模拟与数字电路基础，能独立完成原理图设计、器件选型与板级调试，并讲清每个决策的依据与验证方法；

3、有FPGA或SoC平台硬件开发经验，理解电源、时钟、复位及存储系统的设计要求，熟悉至少一种高速接口的设计与调试；

4、理解SI/PI/EMC基本原理，能据此制定PCB约束、参与Layout评审，并结合实测结果反向改进设计；

5、熟练使用示波器等调试仪器，能结合原理图、波形和系统现象定位问题，区分硬件缺陷与软硬件交互问题；

6、能主动识别设计风险、清晰表达方案取舍，对所负责设计的交付质量负责。



加分项（Nice-to-have）​

1、工业相机、机器视觉或其他成像设备开发经验，熟悉CMOS图像传感器及图像采集链路；

2、高速链路或电源完整性仿真经验，能结合实测评估设计裕量并指导改版；

3、工业设备EMC整改、环境适应性改进或复杂现场问题分析经验。



你将获得（Whatyougain）​

1、看得见的因果：深入图像采集与高速硬件设计，亲眼看到你的电路选择如何转化为成像表现和整机性能；

2、完整的产品闭环：从方案到量产全程参与，用真实工业场景检验设计，而非停留在demo阶段；

3、超越电路的系统视角：与FPGA、软件、光学、结构团队共同解决系统级问题，建立完整的相机系统认知。

title: 雏凤计划：催化剂研发岗
company: 中国中化控股有限责任公司
description:
科研博士专项（雏凤计划）由中国中化总部会同用人单位共同开展，是高潜科研人才招聘培养项目。本岗位由中国中化总部招聘，委托西南化工研究设计院有限公司培养，提供总部统筹培养资源及科研单位一线历练平台。

岗位面向BDO产业链催化剂国产化替代重大需求，针对BDO生产关键催化剂“卡脖子”问题，聚焦合成丁炔二醇铜铋催化剂、甲醇氧化制甲醛铁钼催化剂、贵金属催化氧化催化剂三类核心催化剂，开展自主可控技术攻关。通过研究催化剂前驱体合成、成型工艺、性能评价及工业放大等关键技术，研制性能达到国际先进水平的高耐磨铜铋催化剂、高效传质移热铁钼催化剂和抗水热高精度贵金属催化氧化催化剂。

主要职责：

合成丁炔二醇铜铋催化剂研究放大制备及工业侧线试验。 开展百公斤级工业放大制备，利用沉淀、喷雾造粒等工业设备，重点攻关工业级沉淀装置放大效应和喷雾造粒工艺参数优化；研究批量产品粒径分布（PSD%＜7μm，≤1.50）、堆密度及机械强度调控规律，保证化学组成和物理结构一致性，建立≥100 kg/批次、性能稳定的放大制备工艺。对多批次产品系统抽样，表征粒径、强度、形貌、晶相及反应性能，评估批间一致性与质量稳定性；通过长周期磨损和苛刻条件评价，分析活性、元素含量、微观形貌、反应液离子浓度等变化，研究模拟工业剪切力下破碎机理与活性组分流失路径。在BDO装置工业侧线反应器进行不少于1000 h连续运行考核，监测甲醛转化率、BYD收率、系统压差及滤液铜离子含量，获取工业运行寿命与单耗数据，形成侧线试验考核报告。

甲醇氧化制甲醛铁钼催化剂工业示范应用。 聚焦工业级压片成型工艺，优化粘结剂、脱模剂、造孔剂复配体系及粉体造粒强度、粒径分布、成型压力、模具设计、煅烧曲线等参数，解决强度不均、活性下降等问题，制备轴向抗压强度、活性和选择性对标进口产品的工业规格催化剂。将工业成型催化剂装入工业级单管反应器，模拟真实甲醛装置管程压降、传热条件及原料气组成，进行1000小时稳定性试验，考核甲醇转化率、甲醛收率、副产物及床层压降变化。将定型催化剂在万吨级甲醛装置工业示范应用，与国外催化剂同工况对比甲醇单耗、甲醛浓度、运行周期及综合经济效益，获取客户使用证明，完成首台（套）工业应用。

贵金属催化氧化催化剂工业侧线试验。 突破贵金属定向、均匀负载放大技术，研究工业浸渍釜前驱体溶液浓度、温度控制，优化竞争吸附剂使用策略与规模化焙烧工艺，确保贵金属高分散和载体—活性组分强相互作用，保证起活温度和污染物转化率等指标批次均一稳定。基于实际尾气组分与反应放热，优化上下层催化剂功能协同：上层侧重低温高活性，下层侧重高强度与深度净化，研究最佳装填比例与反应耦合效应，实现床层反应效率最大化。在甲醛装置尾气控制系统搭建侧线装置，引入复杂波动实际工艺尾气，连续考核起活温度、二甲醚转化率及长期稳定性，模拟开停车等非正常工况开展抗水热老化冲击测试。

按不同培养阶段岗位职责完成相关任务，并按“雏凤计划”培养方案参加专业培训和职业素养培训。

任职要求：

学历与专业。 2026—2027届博士，化学工程与技术、工业催化等相关专业；博士期间专注多相催化，具备扎实的催化剂合成与表征研究基础。

核心技能。 精通铜铋、铁钼及贵金属等固体催化剂合成技术；熟练运用XRD、BET、SEM/TEM等表征手段，解析微观结构、诊断失活机理；理解化工单元操作原理，具备工业放大意识，能分析转化率、收率等工业数据。

关键素质。 具备解决复杂技术难题的创新思维和突破传统技术路线的科研潜力，能针对关键科学问题提出前瞻性技术设想或改进思路；兼具成本控制与安全生产视角，愿意深入生产一线参与侧线试验及长周期考核；沟通高效，具备国产化替代使命感，能在高压环境下高效协作。

title: 雏凤计划：工程塑料改性研发工程师
company: 中国中化控股有限责任公司
description:
岗位说明：
“科研博士专项（雏凤计划）”由中国中化总部会同用人单位共同开展，是高潜科研人才招聘培养项目。本岗位由中国中化总部招聘，委托化工事业部培养，提供总部统筹培养资源及科研单位一线历练平台。

岗位主要从事传统工程塑料（PC、PA）及先进共聚工程塑料（PC共聚物、高温尼龙树脂）与改性产品的初始结构、加工过程结构演化表征。

主要职责：

基础树脂深度结构表征。 开展PC、PA及PC共聚物分子量及分布、支化结构、端基种类与含量、共聚序列结构等关键参数深度表征与定量解析，重点突破共聚物序列分布与嵌段长度测定、微量端基定量、宽分布及高分子量样品GPC表征等难点。建立13C/定量NMR、MALDI-TOF质谱、高温GPC-多角度激光光散射联用等方法体系与SOP，形成“分子结构—聚集态结构—化学成分”完整表征能力。建立“分子结构—流变加工性—制品性能”构效关系数据库，支撑原料替代、新牌号选型和竞品深度对标。

复杂配方体系结构表征。 负责增韧、玻纤/碳纤增强、阻燃等多组分体系相形态、分散相尺寸与分布、填料—基体界面结合定量表征（SEM/TEM、SAXS/WAXD、断面分析等），解决“配方相同、性能波动”机理溯源问题。运用蚀刻TEM、界面力学测试等表征界面层结构与结合强度，支撑相容剂选型和配方优化。建立改性体系结晶动力学（DSC/FSC）、晶型与取向（WAXD）表征方法，支撑尺寸稳定性与翘曲控制。

高温尼龙（HTPA）表征能力建设。 针对PA6T、PA9T、PA10T等半芳香族高温尼龙熔点高、结晶速率快、表征窗口窄等特点，建立高温DSC、快速冷却结晶动力学等方法，解析不同成核体系结晶行为差异。建立高温高湿下吸水动力学、增塑—去增塑过程结构与性能演化评价方法。提前构建“结构—加工—性能”表征评价体系与方法包，缩短新品开发验证周期。

加工过程结构演化研究与数据平台建设。 针对挤出、注塑等过程，开展熔体流变、结晶与取向结构演化在线/离线表征，揭示加工历史对聚集态结构和性能的影响，反哺配方设计与工艺优化。系统记录配方、工艺、表征与性能数据，建立结构—性能数据库与追溯体系，定期产出技术报告，为产品线提供疑难表征攻关与技术服务。

按培养阶段完成相关工作任务，并参加“雏凤计划”专业培训和职业素养培训。

任职要求：

学历与经验。 博士学历，高分子化学与物理、材料科学与工程、高分子材料与工程等相关专业；特别优秀者可放宽至硕士并具有3年以上工业界经验。具有完整高分子材料结构表征方法学研究经历，精通至少一种高难度表征手段（NMR、MALDI-TOF、SAXS/WAXD、TEM等），具备方法建立、数据解析到构效关系建立的全链条独立工作能力。有PC、PA、高温PA或PC共聚物表征经历者优先；有多组分复杂体系相结构或界面表征经验者优先。

专业技能。 精通分子链结构表征：1H/13C/定量NMR、GPC（含高温GPC、多检测器联用）、MALDI-TOF、FTIR/Raman等，能独立完成共聚物序列结构、端基、支化度等解析与定量。精通聚集态结构表征：DSC/FSC、WAXD/SAXS、SEM/TEM、AFM、DMA等，具备多组分体系相形态、界面结构与结晶行为定量分析能力。熟悉高分子物理基本理论，能将表征结果转化为配方与工艺优化方向；熟悉双螺杆挤出与注塑加工者优先；有原位/在线表征或同步辐射光源使用经验者优先。

核心能力。 具备较强方法学开发能力，能针对疑难问题设计定制化实验方案并独立完成数据分析，善于将复杂谱学数据转化为明确结论。具备跨团队协作与沟通表达能力，能为多条产品线提供表征支撑，将结构解析结论转化为可执行配方与工艺改进方案。具备文献追踪与技术前沿敏锐度，能快速引入原位表征、高通量表征、机器学习辅助谱图解析等新技术。工作严谨细致，责任心强，实验记录规范，保证数据真实、完整、可追溯。

加分项： 有高温尼龙或PC共聚物结构表征经历；有同步辐射SAXS/WAXD原位表征加工过程结构演化经验；具有海外知名实验室/材料企业表征方法学研究经历，或在高分子领域高水平期刊发表论文。

title: Software Developer
description:
Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard. 
 At Thoughtworks, we believe in going above and beyond the standard and are committed to delivering best-in-class solutions that exceed our clients' expectations. Our standard engineering and delivery practices reflect our commitment to quality, and our team is always looking to innovate and improve. 
 
 Job responsibilities 
 
 
 You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns 
 You will use continuous delivery practices as needed to deliver high-quality software and value to end customers 
 You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients 
 You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way 
 You will partner with other technologists from cross-functional teams advocating and demonstrating DevOps culture 
 You will take ownership and accountability beyond individual deliverables, always pushing the envelope in order to deliver awesome results for our clients 
 You will learn, digest and subsequently apply the latest technology thinking from our  Technology Radar  to solve client problems 
 
 
 Job qualifications 
 
 Technical Skills 
 
 
 You have two or more years* of experience 
 You have experience using one or more development languages (Java, Kotlin, React, TypeScript etc.) with experience in Object-Oriented programming 
 You can write clean, high-quality code in a variety of languages and are also able to spot (and improve) bad code 
 You are familiar with Agile, Lean and/or Continuous Delivery 
 You have a good awareness of TDD, continuous integration and continuous delivery approaches/tools 
 Bonus points if you have knowledge of cloud technology such as AWS, Docker or Kubernetes 
 
 
 Professional Skills 
 
 
 You thrive in a collaborative, non-hierarchical environment that values transparency, openness, feedback and change 
 You have a passion for learning and sharing knowledge as well as a desire to create the right solutions for business problems 
 You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives 
 You're fluent in English, with the ability to handle full English conversations and job interviews seamlessly.（Must have) 
 
 
 
  *For candidates with less than two years of experience,    please visit the Grads and career changers page on our careers site.   
 
 
 Other things to know 
 
 Learning & Development 
 
 There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys. 
 
 
 Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment 
 
 At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.  Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.  We are committed to fairness and responsible AI.

title: Android BSP Engineer

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments.   What we are looking for:  
 As an Android BSP Engineer, you will be responsible for the kernel and driver level system development, which includes building, troubleshooting, and writing automated tests for the Android system on our embedded payments platforms. We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up.

 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams. 
 Design, implement, and maintain drivers and Android services that operate efficiently in a constrained environment and meet the reliability and security requirements of the industry. 
 Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers and communication, and power and performance management and optimization. 
 Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status).

 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation 
 Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product/feature development. Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed.

 Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet. 
 Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system.   Moloco Ads   is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet.   Moloco Commerce Media   is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by  CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture) , the AI system behind every Moloco product. 
 At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer.  Come build what's next.     The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco  
 As a  Senior New Business Manager  for  Greater China , you will own the end‑to‑end acquisition and closing of strategic new logos across mobile apps, gaming, commerce, and streaming in the region. You will develop and execute account‑ and vertical‑level strategies, navigate multi‑stakeholder sales cycles, and shape how prospects in Greater China understand Moloco’s role in their growth. You’ll partner closely with New Business leadership, Growth, Implementation, Product, Data Science, and Marketing to identify the right prospects, craft compelling value propositions, and close complex deals that set customers up for long‑term success. 
  What You’ll Do  
  Partner Leadership & Pipeline Ownership  
 
 Own end‑to‑end new business sales cycles for a portfolio of high‑potential Greater China prospects, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close, with limited input from senior management. 
 Develop and execute account‑level and vertical‑level sales strategies that align Moloco’s solutions with each prospect’s business objectives and long‑term growth plans in Greater China. 
 Build and deepen relationships with management‑level and budget‑holding decision makers (e.g., Heads of UA, CMOs, business owners), earning the right to influence buying decisions and long‑term partnership vision. 
 Maintain a disciplined, accurate pipeline and forecast in CRM, providing clear visibility into deal stages, risks, and upside for the Greater China business. 
 
  Commercial Excellence & Deal Making  
 
 Identify and qualify performance‑driven upsell and expansion opportunities within your book of business in Greater China, designing proposals that balance client outcomes and Moloco revenue. 
 Lead complex deal structuring and negotiations (pricing, terms, tests, incentives) to overcome objections and close high‑value opportunities, leveraging data, benchmarks, and clear trade‑off narratives. 
 Use data‑driven storytelling to articulate business cases, quantify impact, and influence senior client stakeholders to take action (e.g., budget shifts, new product adoption, geo expansion). 
 Partner with Implementation and Growth to ensure clean handoffs and successful ramp‑up for new wins, aligning expectations on KPIs, timelines, and success criteria for the first 90 days and beyond. 
 
  Product Leadership & Solution Design  
 
 Develop a sophisticated understanding of Moloco’s products and the programmatic ecosystem in Greater China, including how our DSP and commerce/streaming solutions fit into a prospect’s broader tech and media stack. 
 Translate prospect needs and pain points into tailored solution designs and test plans, collaborating with Product, DS, and Growth to ensure feasibility, scalability, and strong product‑market fit in the region.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
Jump Trading Group is committed to world class research. We empower exceptional talents in Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science to seek scientific boundaries, push through them, and apply cutting edge research to global financial markets. Our culture is unique. Constant innovation requires fearlessness, creativity, intellectual honesty, and a relentless competitive streak. We believe in winning together and unlocking unique individual talent by incenting collaboration and mutual respect. At Jump, research outcomes drive more than superior risk adjusted returns. We design, develop, and deploy technologies that change our world, fund start-ups across industries, and partner with leading global research organizations and universities to solve problems. 
 Our Data team is responsible for building a world class Data Platform with a centralized source of vendor and proprietary research data. We operate in a very dynamic environment utilizing a sophisticated and diverse technology stack. The team interfaces with all aspects of the firm, from Trading, Research, and Technology to Risk, Middle Office and Accounting – providing individuals within the group a full 360-degree view of Jump. Our Proprietary Data team collects and builds research-ready datasets, financial and non-financial, from primary sources, vendors, and public data; cleans, tags, and organizes them with consistent identifiers, taxonomies, and metadata; sources data not available from vendors and evaluates its quality and provenance. It performs deep data analysis, identifies and corrects data quality issues, and surfaces the conventions behind the datasets we use. The team provides human-in-the-loop review for automated and AI-driven pipelines; and partners with engineers to turn manual workflows into repeatable, automated processes. 
 This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, working closely with researchers, traders, and engineers across the firm. The role offers the individual the opportunity to develop both business and technical expertise, while significantly contributing to our whole platform. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 The ideal candidate will be able to dig into the details of the data and work with end-users to understand their needs and deliver results. We are looking for individuals who are instinctively curious self-starters, demonstrating the ability to independently drive tasks and projects to completion in a team environment. Curiosity, focus, attention to detail, and a genuine enjoyment of learning are essential to this role. 
 As Lead Data Analyst, you will lead that team day to day. You will: · Coordinate the team’s work: translate requests from researchers, traders, and engineers into well-defined projects, set priorities across competing demands, and drive them to completion. 
 Own quality: set the standards for how data is collected, tagged, documented, and validated, and review the team’s output before it reaches the researchers and traders who depend on it. 
 Guide individual analysts: assign work suited to each analyst’s strengths and development, give regular and specific feedback, and coach them on data research techniques and the effective use of modern AI tools. 
 Stay hands-on: take on the most ambiguous and highest-stakes data problems yourself, and model the curiosity and rigor expected of the team. 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for the team: understand the business needs, communicate findings and status clearly and concisely, and manage expectations. 
 Partner with data engineers to decide which manual workflows to automate and ensure automated and AI-driven pipelines keep appropriate human-in-the-loop review. 
 Other duties as assigned or needed.  
 
 Skills You'll Need: 
 
 7+ years of hands-on experience working with data in the financial industry, at a trading firm, hedge fund, bank, or a vendor serving those institutions. 
 3+ years of experience leading complex projects and other analysts.

title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, Data Engineering
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
  Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
 Netskope's Data Platform is the backbone behind every security insight our customers see, ingesting and processing security telemetry from a global edge network at massive scale. We own the full data path — from collection at the edge, through stream processing and enrichment, to the query, routing, and delivery systems that put that data in customers' hands. On top of that foundation we build the analytics, reporting, and export capabilities that our customers rely on to understand and act on their security posture. We are now investing in an AI-native future, building a semantic layer that makes our data machine-interpretable and agentic experiences that let customers ask questions of their data in natural language. 
  What you’ll work on  
 
 Partner with architects to design and evolve the systems that carry telemetry from global edge ingestion through processing, query, and customer delivery, with a focus on scale, durability & latency. 
 Raise the bar on observability, SLOs, deployment safety, and production resilience of the platform that others build on top of - not just a single service. 
 Build the AI-native semantic layer that’s the foundation to make our data machine-interpretable, and the agentic experiences on top of it that let customers ask questions in natural language.  
 Lead cross-team initiatives, shaping architecture through design reviews, and mentoring engineers, with the freedom to adopt modern & open source technologies. 
 
  Required skills and experience  
 
 10+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with significant time operating at Staff-level (or equivalent) technical scope. 
 Strong coding ability in one or more of Go, Java, Python, or C++, with a track record of shipping production systems, not just designing them. 
 Experience designing for reliability at scale — observability, SLOs, incident response, and safe deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes). 
 Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: influencing architecture decisions, driving design decisions, and aligning teams around a direction. 
 Experience building high-throughput ingestion and data services over modern RPC and wire protocols — HTTP/2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers — including schema design and evolution.  
 Experience with high-throughput data pipelines — data streaming & batch ingestion, processing, and storage using columnar data formats such as Parquet  
 Excellent written and verbal communication, and the flexibility to collaborate across time zones with globally distributed teams.  
 Ability to ramp up quickly into unfamiliar codebases and domains as priorities evo

company: 中南知了（湖南）文化科技有限公司
description:
一、岗位职责

产品规划与架构设计： 负责教育内容生产管理、AIGC内容创作及精准教学相关产品的规划、需求分析、业务架构和功能设计，面向专业编辑、一线教师及教研人员等用户，构建教育内容生产、管理、应用相衔接的产品体系。
教育内容生产与管理平台设计： 负责教育内容生产、加工、标引、审核、发布及运营管理平台的产品设计，深入理解专业编辑和一线教师的业务流程，设计内容生产工作流、资源分类体系、知识点标引、内容关联、协同编辑、权限管理、版本控制及质量追溯等功能，提升教育内容生产效率和资源管理水平。
AIGC教育内容生产工具设计： 负责AIGC知识点微课制作及智能内容生产工具的规划与设计，结合大语言模型、多模态生成、图像生成、语音合成及视频生成等技术，设计教学脚本生成、分镜策划、素材生成、音视频合成、内容编辑、审核发布等产品功能，推动教育内容生产的智能化、标准化和规模化。
精准教学产品设计： 围绕教材教辅、教学资源、知识点、试题、作业及学习评价等核心要素，规划精准教学相关产品功能，设计智能资源检索、教学资源组课、作业分析、错题管理、知识点诊断、针对性练习及教学反馈等应用场景，推动教育内容资源与教学业务深度融合。
教师AI助教产品设计： 负责教师AI助教及相关教学智能应用的产品规划与设计，设计智能备课、资源推荐、教案生成、作业讲评、教学分析及教研辅助等功能，优化AI交互流程、内容检索与引用机制，提升智能教学服务的准确性、实用性和易用性。
产品研发与交付管理：独立完成产品原型、需求文档、业务流程、功能规则及验收标准设计，协同UI/UX设计、研发、算法、测试、教研及内容团队，推动产品从需求分析、MVP验证、研发实施、测试上线到持续迭代的全生命周期管理。
产品质量与数据运营： 建立内容生产效率、资源质量、AI生成效果、产品使用及教学应用等指标体系，持续优化产品功能与服务质量，推动教育内容有效应用和产品价值提升。
业务协同与产品经营： 推动集团教材教辅、数字教育资源、教研成果及AI技术能力的产品化整合，协同内容、技术、运营及市场团队探索教育内容服务和智能教学应用模式，关注内容资产复用、用户价值、技术成本及产品可持续运营。

二、任职要求

学历与工作经验： 本科及以上学历，计算机、教育技术学、数字出版、编辑出版、教育学等相关专业优先；具有4年以上互联网产品或数字化产品工作经验，具备独立负责复杂业务平台、教育内容平台或AI应用产品规划、设计及落地的实际经历。
平台型产品设计能力： 熟悉平台型产品的规划与设计方法，具备较强的业务需求分析、产品架构设计、业务建模、信息架构、流程设计及产品全生命周期管理能力，能够独立完成复杂业务系统的产品方案设计并推动研发交付。
教育内容与出版业务理解： 熟悉教育内容生产、数字出版或教育资源管理相关业务，理解专业编辑、内容审核及一线教师的工作流程；了解教育资源结构化、知识点体系、内容标引、资源关联、版权管理及内容质量控制等业务，有数字出版、教育内容平台或内容管理系统产品经验者优先。
教学业务与精准教学理解： 理解学校教学、教师备课、课堂教学、作业练习及学习评价等基本业务场景，熟悉或了解教材知识体系、教学资源组织、学情分析、错题管理和精准教学等业务逻辑；具有智慧教育、教学应用、题库或精准教学产品设计经验者优先。
AI及AIGC产品设计能力： 了解大语言模型、RAG、智能体及多模态生成等技术的基本原理和应用边界，能够结合教育内容生产和教学场景设计AI产品功能、交互流程、提示词及效果评价机制；具有AI内容生产、AI备课、智能教学助手或AIGC微课制作工具实际项目经验者优先。
产品设计与项目协作工具： 熟练使用Figma、Axure、MasterGo、墨刀等至少一种产品原型及交互设计工具，能够独立完成产品原型和交互说明；熟悉XMind、ProcessOn等流程与架构设计工具，以及Jira、TAPD、禅道等至少一种项目协作管理工具。
数据分析与技术协作能力： 熟练使用Excel等工具进行业务数据整理与分析，具备产品指标设计、数据分析及效果评估能力；了解API接口、数据库、数据结构及系统集成基本原理，掌握SQL或主流BI工具者优先。
AI工具实践能力： 具备ChatGPT、DeepSeek等主流生成式AI工具的实际使用经验，能够运用AI辅助开展需求分析、产品设计、原型验证及方案优化；熟悉Dify、Coze等AI工作流或智能体开发工具，以及AI图像、语音、视频生成工具者优先。

【请对照任职要求，充分准备案例作品。包括但不限于：交互式原型作品、业务流程图、系统功能结构、思维导图、PRD文档。】
【薪酬按岗位职级与面试评估核定，中/高级税前年薪预计20-40万，专家级税前年薪预计40-60万。】

title: Office Manager, China (Executive Administration and Workplace)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
 This position needs to be   based in the Beijing, China office 5 days a week. No Visa/Relocation Support.   
   
  The Community you will join:  
 The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering. 
 This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience. The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life. 
 This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected. 
 This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings. 
   
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service. 
 You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected. 
 Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

  Support the Office Experience  
 
 Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.

 Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services. 
 Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed. 
 Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments. 
 
  Coordinate Office Operations  
 
 Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities. 
 Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution. 
 Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback. 
 Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions. 
 Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team. 
 Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes. 
 Support implementation of office standards and playbooks. 
 Support office utilization reporting. 
 
  Leadership & Administrative Support  
 
 Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager. 
 Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager. 
 Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings. 
 Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.

title: Senior Research Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Senior Research Engineer to join our   Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial and innovative culture at the heart of its business. We value quick-witted, creative minds and challenge them to make full use of their capacities.  
 As a Senior Research Engineer, you will be responsible for helping to lead the development of our trading model research framework and using it to conduct research to develop models for trading in production. You'll expand the framework to become global standard way of training, consuming, combining, and transforming any data source in a data-driven systematic way. You will then partner with Quantitative Researchers to build the trading models themselves. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Help to lead the development and global rollout of our research framework for defining and training models through various optimization procedures (supervised learning, backtesting etc.), as well as its integration with our platform for deploying and running those models in production 
 Partner with Quantitative Researchers to conduct research: test hypotheses and tune/develop data-driven systematic trading strategies and alpha signals 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Machine Learning, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or similar 
 5+ years of hands-on experience MLOps, Research Engineering, or ML Research 
 A strong background in mathematics and statistics 
 Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, with experience in libraries like numpy, pytorch, polars, pandas, and ray. 
 Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing end-to-end machine learning pipelines, including data preprocessing, model training, deployment, and monitoring 
 Understanding of and experience with modern software development practices and tools (e.g. Agile, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability) 
 Understanding of cloud platforms (e. g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e. g., Docker, Kubernetes) 
 
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

 Architecting and implementing critical software infrastructure for distributed large-scale multi-cloud environments

  Required skills and experience  
 
 8+ years of experience including 2+ years of experience building cloud environments  
 Excellent Unix/Linux experience and programming experience with Go, C/C++, Java and scripting: Python, Ruby, Shell

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 Bonus points for experience with Node.js & Express to build REST APIs services 
 
  Education  
 
 BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer - Linux, PC, IoT
description:
Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, “the world’s best free software platform”. The Commercial Engineering Quality Assurance (QA) team works with all the engineering teams in Canonical, OEM and ODM customers, to bring Ubuntu directly to millions of users by delivering certified Ubuntu laptop, desktop, IoT and other computing devices. 
 As a Software QA engineer, you will join the team responsible for our strategy for quality coordination and testing. You will be a quality expert with extensive experience establishing quality processes from the ground up. You will understand the tools and techniques used to introduce new products, and will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. 
 Location: This is an office-based role in Beijing. 
  As a Software Quality Assurance Engineer you will:  
 
 Plan, create and manage the overall Quality Planning strategy and document 
 Improve our automated test capability with design and code contributions 
 Perform automated and manual testing of Ubuntu Desktop, Server and Core on varies latest hardware. 
 Suggest solutions to identified product problems 
 Collaborate with the Project team to ensure consistent project execution 
 Identify quality assurance process bottleneck and suggest improvements 
 Oversee continuous improvement projects  
 Collect quality data 
 Establish proactive measures to improve the quality and reliability of the Ubuntu platform 
 Prepare time estimates and schedule for testing activities 
 Identify, isolate, and document bugs clearly and concisely in the bugs database 
 Work with development teams across multiple projects to build efficient, effective automated testing 
 Communicate effectively with colleagues in a variety of time zones around the world 
 Triage test reports and customer bugs 
 
  The successful Software Quality Assurance Engineer will have :  
 
 Experience with the Linux desktop, and related technologies. Ubuntu experience would be a plus 
 Solid grasp of commercial Software QA practices and ideas on how to integrate them into Linux Community standards 
 Experience with common scripting languages, including Shell script, Python or JavaScript 
 Comfortable with online communication and collaboration such as mailing lists, Mattermost, wiki 
 Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills 
 Strong written and spoken communication skills in English 
 Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team 
 Ability to pick up new technologies and achieve high effectiveness quickly 
 
  What Canonical Offers:  
 
 Learning and development 
 Annual compensation review 
 Recognition rewards 
 Annual leave 
 Priority Pass for travel 
 Annual health check 
 
  About Canonical  
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. 
 Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Trading Intern
description:
Flow Traders is looking for entrepreneurial, competitive, and analytical students to join our Trading department as an Intern. What better way to find out if a career in Trading is something for you, than by experiencing it yourself as a Trading Intern! 
 You will get a 360-degree view of our role in the financial markets, how our Traders seize opportunities, and how they work together as a team to optimize and improve their trading desk. This Trading internship is about immersing yourself in the financial markets and experiencing trading up close. You do not need to have a financial background; we will teach you all you need to know. 
 Experience with a scientific programming language or excel is a definite advantage. Working closely with Traders and Quantitative Researchers, you will add value by working on real trading projects. You will solve problems, create new tools and/or design new strategies. You will test your project in a trading simulation. 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Learn directly from industry leaders on the APAC Trading floor 
 Participate in educational courses and trading simulations 
 Design trading strategies through project-based work using quantitative modelling and trading applications 
 Work through real life trading problems with our Traders and Quantitative Researchers 
 Gain insight into Flow Traders’ core business 
 Participate in intern activities and become a part of our “One Team” culture 
 
  Internship Duration    
 
 June 2027 - July 2027/ December 2027 - January 2028 
 This is a full-time paid internship and will last for 6 weeks 
 Flight and accommodation will be provided to all successful overseas applicants. 
 
 What You Need to Succeed 
 
 Graduating between August 2027 and December 2028 with a Degree in Finance, Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related disciplines 
 Experience with a scientific programming language (e.g. Python / MATLAB / R or similar) 
 Competitive, innovative & creative personality with excellent mental arithmetic skills 
 Capability to reason logically and deliver under pressure 
 Ability to spot opportunities and the assertiveness to seize them   
 
  If you do not receive a confirmation email after you applied on our website, please contact  careers.hongkong@hk.flowtraders.com .  
  Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed the sole property of Flow Traders, and no placement fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Assistance Engineering
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.     Your Location:  
  This position is CHINA BASED . The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. Your recruiter will inform you what cities you are able to work from depending on your personal legal working identity and Airbnb internal policies. 
   
  The Community You Will Join:  
 Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.  
 The Community Support Products (CSP) Machine Learning team is the core team responsible for driving CSxAI (Customer Support x Artificial Intelligence) initiatives by adopting the Generative AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional service experience. The team develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and tools including LLM fine-tuning and optimization, RAG/Search,  LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.  
 The richness of Airbnb's data, the complexity of its marketplace and the variety innate in our product mean that we need to operate at the state of the art of AI practice. We are committed to investing in long term innovation to solve the complex problems we face, and to do that we need the very best experts in ML and AI to join us. 
   
  The Difference You Will Make:  
 We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.  
 You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.  
 Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities. 
   
  A Typical Day:   
 
 
 Envision, champion, and support the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems 
 
 
 Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products 
 
 
 Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team across regions( China and the US).  
 
 
   
  Your Expertise:  
 
 PhD/Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience 
 2-4 years of ML engineering experience, with ownership responsibility over large-scale software systems.  
 Background in the design and development of AI and ML systems and services, and a deep passion for building efficient and scalable ML-powered products 
 Experience with LLM driven chatbot and Agentic AI products would be a big plus 
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a team and with teams across the engineering, product & design organizations 
  Fluency in both English and Mandarin is essential.

description:

title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer
location: Home Based - APAC; Office Based - Beijing, China; Office Based - Taipei, Taiwan
description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale. 
 The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. title: Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality and Test Engineering
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform,  Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives  such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. 
 The company is founder led, profitable and growing. 
 We are hiring an  Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Hardware Certification Quality Engineering , to lead the team responsible for the test suites which validate hardware compatibility with Ubuntu Linux (Core, Desktop and Server – see  https://ubuntu.com/certified  for more information). We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices. 
 As the Engineering Manager of the Certification Quality team you’ll lead a dedicated testing team, shaping the vision and setting the pace, in collaboration with the rest of the Certification and hardware enablement teams. You will lead the certification test strategy for Canonical’s PC OEM and ODM partnerships, including Advantech, ASUS, Dell, HP,  and Lenovo, deepening the test coverage for both new and existing certified hardware. You will pioneer the use of Canonical’s open source test frameworks and custom designed hardware to drive automated hardware validation of the operating system. This is a challenging position for a quality focused engineering leader, and requires an analytical mind with a passion for test automation and team leadership. 
  Location:  This role will be office based in Taipei Minsheng district, Taiwan. 
 This role entails 
 
 Lead the development and maintenance of Canonical’s hardware certification test suite 
 Manage timely delivery of certifications as part of the hardware certification programmes 
 Work collaboratively to ensure continuous improvement of test practices and tools 
 Build and lead a globally distributed team of engineers 
 Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development 
 Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders 
 Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation

 Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

 Knowledge of low-level embedded software and hardware - BIOS, firmware, bootloaders, ACPI, devicetree, kernel, RTOS 
 A good understanding of Linux system architecture 
 Knowledge of quality and reliability oriented engineering practices 
 Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

 Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
